• Select a STYLE. Then just tap, tap and tap again on this style to find your favorite random design.
• Want to manually rearrange text position? Just open Layer mode (the icon on the top-left corner, next to the back button) for detailed editing
• While you're at the place of choosing the color for the text, tap the Random-Button will set different colors for EACH letter
